title: A constant adic quotient realization reflects isomorphisms of maps
statement: Under the hypotheses of the constant quotient realization statement, a morphism of the two derived coefficient objects is an isomorphism whenever its constant adic quotient realization is an isomorphism.

source.place: Tags 093J and 03Q3, the nonempty-chart stalk detection part

proof.text: Use the completion quotient comparison to move the realized isomorphism to the coefficient-level constant realization. Exactness of the stalk functor and constant-section detection on the supplied nonempty etale chart force the kernel and cokernel to vanish. The derived isomorphism criterion then yields IsIso for the original coefficient map.

theorem constantAdicQuotientRealization_reflects_iso_of_map
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) (n : ℕ)
    (W : Y.Etale) (_w : W.left)
    (E F : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
      (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1))))
    (f : E ⟶ F)
    (hf : IsIso ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).map f)) :
    IsIso f
